        knob.ZIndex = 6
        knob.Parent = track
        Corner(knob, 8)

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 8
        btn.Parent = card

        local on = false
        local cfgKey = "toggle:" .. name

        local function applyVisual(state, animate)
            on = state and true or false
            local knobOn = UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8)
            local knobOff = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
            if on then
                if animate then
                    Tween(knob, F, {Position = knobOn, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0})
                    Tween(track, F, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 26, 16)})
                else
                    knob.Position = knobOn
                    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    knob.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 26, 16)
                end
            else
                if animate then
                    Tween(knob, F, {Position = knobOff, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 95, 60), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4})
                    Tween(track, F, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 14, 13)})
                else
                    knob.Position = knobOff
                    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 95, 60)
                    knob.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
                    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 14, 13)
                end
            end
        end

        local function setState(state, animate)
            state = state and true or false
            if on == state then return end
            applyVisual(state, animate ~= false)
            Config.set(cfgKey, on)
            setToggleSaved(name, on)
            if cb then task.spawn(cb, on) end
        end

        local function doToggle() setState(not on, true) end
        btn.Activated:Connect(doToggle)
        attachKeybind(btn, nameLbl, name, doToggle)

        local saved = (name ~= "Instant Reset") and getToggleSaved(name, Config.get(cfgKey, false)) or false
        if saved then task.defer(function() setState(true, false) end) end

        local reg = { card = card, set = setState, setState = setState, getState = function() return on end, applyVisual = applyVisual }
        _ToggleReg[name] = reg
        return reg
    end

    local function setToggleUI(name, state, silent)
        local reg = _ToggleReg[name]
        if reg and reg.setState then
            reg.setState(state and true or false, not silent)
        else
            pcall(function()
                if setToggleSaved then
                    setToggleSaved(name, state and true or false)
                else
                    Config.set("toggle:" .. name, state and true or false)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    _G._KiroSetToggleUI = setToggleUI

    local function Button(parent, name, desc, cb, _h)
        local hasDesc = desc and desc ~= ""
        local h = _h or (hasDesc and 50 or 36)
        local card = Card(parent, h)
        local nameY = hasDesc and 6 or (h/2 - 10)
        local nameLbl = Lbl(card, name, 13, Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
        nameLbl.Size     = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, nameY)
        nameLbl.ZIndex   = 5

        if hasDesc then
            local d = Lbl(card, desc, 11, Color3.fromRGB(180, 175, 170), Enum.Font.Gotham, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
            d.Size     = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
            d.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, nameY + 18)
            d.ZIndex   = 5
        end

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text                   = ""
        btn.AutoButtonColor        = false
        btn.ZIndex                 = 7
        btn.Parent                 = card

        local function press()
            Tween(card, F, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 32, 22)})
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                Tween(card, M, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 18, 16)})
            end)
            if cb then task.spawn(cb) end
        end
        btn.Activated:Connect(press)
        attachKeybind(btn, nameLbl, name, press)
    end

    local _SliderReg = {}
    local _activeSliderDrag = nil

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        local s = _activeSliderDrag
        if not s then return end
        if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        s.setFromX(inp.Position.X)
    end)

    local function Slider(parent, name, mn, mx, def, cb, step, onCommit)
        local card = Card(parent, 52)
        local v = def or mn
        local _step     = step or 1
        local _decimals = math.max(0, math.ceil(-math.log(math.max(_step, 1e-9)) / math.log(10)))
        local _fmt      = "%." .. _decimals .. "f"

        local nameLbl = Lbl(card, name, 13, Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), Enum.Font.GothamBold)
        nameLbl.Size     = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 18)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
        nameLbl.ZIndex   = 5

        local vBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
        vBox.Size                  = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 20)
        vBox.Position              = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 6)
        vBox.BackgroundColor3      = Color3.fromRGB(15, 14, 13)
        vBox.BorderSizePixel       = 0
        vBox.Text                  = string.format(_fmt, v)
        vBox.Font                  = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        vBox.TextSize              = 11
        vBox.TextColor3            = Color3.fromRGB(245, 160, 50)
        vBox.TextXAlignment        = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        vBox.ClearTextOnFocus      = false
        vBox.ZIndex                = 6
        vBox.Parent                = card
        Corner(vBox, 6)
        local vBoxStroke = Stroke(vBox, Color3.fromRGB(245, 115, 30), 1, 0)

        local trk = Instance.new("Frame")
        trk.Size             = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 4)
        trk.Position         = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 34)
        trk.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 25, 20)
        trk.BorderSizePixel  = 0
        trk.ZIndex           = 5
        trk.Parent           = card
        Corner(trk, 2)
        Stroke(trk, Color3.fromRGB(245, 115, 30), 1, 0)

        local frac = (v - mn) / math.max(1, mx - mn)
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.Size            = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 115, 30)
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.ZIndex          = 6
        fill.Parent          = trk
        Corner(fill, 2)

        local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
        knob.Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
        knob.AnchorPoint      = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        knob.Position         = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 0.5, 0)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        knob.BorderSizePixel  = 0
        knob.ZIndex           = 7
        knob.Parent           = trk
        Corner(knob, 8)
        Stroke(knob, Color3.fromRGB(245, 115, 30), 1.5, 0)

        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
        hit.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 16, 0, 24)
        hit.Position               = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0.5, -12)
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Text                   = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor        = false
        hit.ZIndex                 = 8
        hit.Parent                 = trk

        local cfgKey = "slider:" .. name
        local _entry

        local function setValue(n, fromBox, fromPeer)
            n = tonumber(string.format(_fmt, math.clamp(math.floor(n / _step + 0.5) * _step, mn, mx)))
            v = n
            local f = (v - mn) / math.max(1e-9, mx - mn)
            fill.Size     = UDim2.new(f, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(f, 0, 0.5, 0)
            if not fromBox then vBox.Text = string.format(_fmt, v) end
            if not fromPeer then
                Config.set(cfgKey, v)
                if cb then cb(v) end
                local reg = _SliderReg[cfgKey]
                if reg then
                    for _, peer in ipairs(reg) do
                        if peer ~= _entry then peer.setVisualOnly(v) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        _entry = { setVisualOnly = function(val) setValue(val, false, true) end }
        _SliderReg[cfgKey] = _SliderReg[cfgKey] or {}
        table.insert(_SliderReg[cfgKey], _entry)

        vBox.Focused:Connect(function() Tween(vBoxStroke, F, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 50)}) end)
        vBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            Tween(vBoxStroke, F, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 115, 30)})
            local n = tonumber(vBox.Text)
            if n then setValue(n, true) end
            vBox.Text = string.format(_fmt, v)
            if onCommit then onCommit(v) end
            pcall(Config.flush)
        end)

        local function setFromX(px)
            local f = math.clamp((px - trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, trk.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
            setValue(mn + (mx - mn) * f)
        end

        local _dragHandle = { setFromX = setFromX }
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                _activeSliderDrag = _dragHandle
                setFromX(inp.Position.X)
                Tween(knob, F, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)})
            end
        end)
        hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if _activeSliderDrag == _dragHandle then _activeSliderDrag = nil end
                Tween(knob, F, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)})
                if onCommit then onCommit(v) end
                pcall(Config.flush)
            end
        end)

        task.defer(function() pcall(setValue, Config.get(cfgKey, def or mn)) end)
        if onCommit then task.defer(function() if v ~= nil then pcall(onCommit, v) end end) end

        return { card = card, set = function(nv) pcall(setValue, nv) end }
    end

        local B = _G.__KiroBridge

        local getToggleSaved, setToggleSaved = B.getToggleSaved, B.setToggleSaved
        local rootScale, visible, setVisible = B.rootScale, B.visible, B.setVisible
        local Vis = B.Vis or _G._FH_Vis or { open = true }
        local ThemeGrads, ThemeSolids = B.ThemeGrads, B.ThemeSolids

        local setToggleUI = B.setToggleUI

        local _GEN = B._GEN
        local noop = function(state) end

        local Steal, startAutoSteal, stopAutoSteal

    local __gIIFE_2 = (function()
        repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local TS = TweenService or game:GetService("TweenService")
        local UIS = UserInputService or game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

        -- ============================================================
        -- STEAL STATE
        -- ============================================================
        local Steal = {
            AutoStealEnabled = true,
            StealRadius = 55,
            StealDuration = 0.2,
            Mode = "half",
            HalfFireRange = 10,
            HalfHoldMin = 1.3,
            HalfHoldMax = 2.6,
            HalfEntryDelay = 0.3,
            Data = {},
            TargetEnabled = false,
            TargetName = nil,
            TargetKey = nil,
            TargetPlot = nil,
            TargetSlot = nil,
        }

        local isStealing = false
        local stealStartTime = nil
        local autoConn = nil
        local currentTargetInfo = { name = "", money = "" }
        local giantPotionEnabled = false

        local function isMyPlotByName(plotName)
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return false end
            local plot = plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
            if not plot then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if sign then
                local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    return yb.Enabled == true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function isValidStealPrompt(pr)
            if not pr or not pr.Parent or not pr.Enabled then return false end
            local act = pr.ActionText
            return act and (string.find(act, "Steal") ~= nil or string.find(act, "Grab") ~= nil)
        end

        -- Format number like 5.2M, 120K, etc.
        local function formatMoney(n)
            if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
            local abs = math.abs(n)
            if abs >= 1e12 then
                return string.format("%.1fT", n / 1e12):gsub("%.0T", "T")
            elseif abs >= 1e9 then
                return string.format("%.1fB", n / 1e9):gsub("%.0B", "B")
            elseif abs >= 1e6 then
                return string.format("%.1fM", n / 1e6):gsub("%.0M", "M")
            elseif abs >= 1e3 then
                return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3):gsub("%.0K", "K")
            else
                return tostring(math.floor(n))
            end
        end

        -- Get name + $/s from prompt / spawn (mme systme que le gros script)
        local function getBrainrotInfo(prompt, spawn)
            local name, money = "", ""

            -- 1) ObjectText du ProximityPrompt
            if prompt and prompt.ObjectText and prompt.ObjectText ~= "" then
                name = prompt.ObjectText
            end

            -- 2) AnimalOverhead Billboard
            if spawn then
                local att = spawn:FindFirstChild("Attachment") or spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                if att then
                    local overhead = att:FindFirstChild("AnimalOverhead")
                    if overhead and overhead:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        local displayName = overhead:FindFirstChild("DisplayName")
                        if displayName and displayName:IsA("TextLabel") and displayName.Text ~= "" then
                            if name == "" then
                                name = displayName.Text
                            end
                        end
                        -- Cherche un label avec $ ou /s
                        for _, child in ipairs(overhead:GetDescendants()) do
                            if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                local t = child.Text
                                if t and (t:find("%$") or t:find("/s") or t:find("M/s") or t:find("K/s") or t:find("B/s") or t:find("T/s")) then
                                    money = t:gsub("%s+", "")
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                -- 3) Fallback : n'importe quel BillboardGui sous le podium
                if name == "" or money == "" then
                    local podium = spawn.Parent and spawn.Parent.Parent
                    if podium then
                        for _, gui in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
                            if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") or gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                                for _, label in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                        local t = label.Text
                                        if name == "" and t and #t > 2 and not t:find("%$") and not t:find("/s") and not tonumber(t) then
                                            name = t
                                        end
                                        if money == "" and t and (t:find("%$") or t:find("/s")) then
                                            money = t:gsub("%s+", "")
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- 4) Module Animals si disponible
            if money == "" and name ~= "" then
                pcall(function()
                    local Animals = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Datas.Animals)
                    if Animals and Animals[name] then
                        local gen = Animals[name].Generation or Animals[name].generation or Animals[name].Income or Animals[name].Gen or 0
                        if type(gen) == "number" and gen > 0 then
                            money = "$" .. formatMoney(gen) .. "/s"
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            return name, money
        end

        local function findNearestPrompt()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return nil end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if not root then return nil end

            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end

            local nearest, dist = nil, math.huge
            local nearestSpawn = nil

            -- Priority Steal Target integration: ignore all other brainrots if a target is selected
            local hasPriority = (Steal.TargetEnabled == true and Steal.TargetKey ~= nil)

            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if plot:IsA("Model") and not isMyPlotByName(plot.Name) then
                    -- If priority is active, ignore other plots
                    if hasPriority and Steal.TargetPlot and plot.Name ~= Steal.TargetPlot then
                        continue
                    end

                    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    if pods then
                        for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                            -- If priority is active, ignore other slots
                            if hasPriority and Steal.TargetSlot then
                                local slotNum = tonumber(pod.Name:match("%d+"))
                                if slotNum and slotNum ~= Steal.TargetSlot then
                                    continue
                                end
                            end

                            local base = pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
                            local sp = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                            if sp then
                                local d = (sp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                                if d <= Steal.StealRadius and d < dist then
                                    local found = nil
                                    local att = sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                                    if att then
                                        for _, pr in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                                            if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and pr.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                                found = pr
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if not found then
                                        for _, pr in ipairs(sp:GetDescendants()) do
                                            if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and pr.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                                found = pr
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if found then
                                        nearest = found
                                        dist = d
                                        nearestSpawn = sp
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Update target info
            if nearest and nearestSpawn then
                local n, m = getBrainrotInfo(nearest, nearestSpawn)
                currentTargetInfo.name = n
                currentTargetInfo.money = m
            else
                currentTargetInfo.name = ""
                currentTargetInfo.money = ""
            end

            return nearest
        end

        local function _promptDist(prompt)
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return math.huge end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if not root then return math.huge end
            local part = prompt.Parent
            if part and part:IsA("Attachment") then part = part.Parent end
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                return (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            end
            local ok, cf = pcall(function()
                return prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.WorldPosition
            end)
            if ok and cf then
                return (cf - root.Position).Magnitude
            end
            return math.huge
        end

        local function executeSteal(prompt)
            if isStealing then return end
            if not Steal.Data[prompt] then
                Steal.Data[prompt] = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
                if getconnections then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                        if c.Function then table.insert(Steal.Data[prompt].hold, c.Function) end
                    end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                        if c.Function then table.insert(Steal.Data[prompt].trigger, c.Function) end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function setStealingState(val)
                isStealing = val and true or false
                _G._KiroIsStealing = isStealing
            end
            local data = Steal.Data[prompt]
            if not data or not data.ready then return end
            data.ready = false
            setStealingState(true)
            stealStartTime = tick()

            if Steal.Mode == "half" then
                task.spawn(function()
                    for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end
                    task.wait(Steal.HalfHoldMin)
                    local inRange = _promptDist(prompt) <= Steal.HalfFireRange
                    while true do
                        if not Steal.AutoStealEnabled then
                            data.ready = true
                            isStealing = false
                            return
                        end
                        local el = tick() - stealStartTime
                        if el > Steal.HalfHoldMax or not prompt.Parent then break end
                        if _promptDist(prompt) <= Steal.HalfFireRange then
                            if not inRange then task.wait(Steal.HalfEntryDelay) end
                            if not Steal.AutoStealEnabled then
                                data.ready = true
                                isStealing = false
                                return
                            end
                            for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(fn) end
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait()
                    end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    data.ready = true
                    setStealingState(false)
                end)
            else
                task.spawn(function()
                    for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end
                    local el = 0
                    while el < Steal.StealDuration do
                        if not Steal.AutoStealEnabled then
                            data.ready = true
                            setStealingState(false)
                            return
                        end
                        el = el + task.wait()
                    end
                    for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(fn) end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    data.ready = true
                    setStealingState(false)
                end)
            end
        end

        local spScreenGui, container, nameLabel, spFrame, spFill, spPct

        local function startAutoSteal()
            if autoConn then return end
            Steal.AutoStealEnabled = true
            autoConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not Steal.AutoStealEnabled or isStealing then return end
                local p = findNearestPrompt()
                if p then executeSteal(p) end
            end)
            if container then container.Visible = true end
        end

        local function stopAutoSteal()
            if autoConn then
                autoConn:Disconnect()
                autoConn = nil
            end
            Steal.AutoStealEnabled = false
            isStealing = false
            _G._KiroIsStealing = false
            if container then container.Visible = false end
        end

        Steal.isStealing = function() return isStealing end
        _G.AutoSteal = Steal

        -- ============================================================
        -- RED AUTO STEAL GUI - barre + nom brainrot au-dessus
        -- ============================================================
        do
            pcall(function()
                local roots = {}
                pcall(function() if typeof(gethui) == "function" then table.insert(roots, gethui()) end end)
                pcall(function() if game:GetService("CoreGui") then table.insert(roots, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end end)
                pcall(function() if LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") then table.insert(roots, LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end end)
                for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
                    for _, c in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
                        if c.Name == "StealProgressScreenGui" then
                            pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            spScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            spScreenGui.Name = "StealProgressScreenGui"
            spScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

            spScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            spScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                    spScreenGui.Parent = gethui()

                pcall(function() spScreenGui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)

            -- Container (name + bar)

            container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            container.BorderSizePixel = 0
            container.ZIndex = 300

            -- Nom du brainrot + $/s (vert comme la capture)
            nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
            nameLabel.Name = "BrainrotName"
            nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
            nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nameLabel.Text = ""

            nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

            nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
            nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            nameLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
            nameLabel.ZIndex = 305

            spFrame = Instance.new("Frame", container)
            spFrame.Name = "StealProgressGui"
            spFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 22)
            spFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
            spFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
            spFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 15, 20)
            spFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            spFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            spFrame.Active = true
            spFrame.Visible = true
            spFrame.ZIndex = 300
            spFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
            Instance.new("UICorner", spFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

            -- Fill rouge solide (pas de shine)
            spFill = Instance.new("Frame", spFrame)
            spFill.Name = "ProgressFill"
            spFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            spFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            spFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 45, 55)
            spFill.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            spFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
            spFill.ZIndex = 301
            spFill.ClipsDescendants = true
            Instance.new("UICorner", spFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

            -- Pourcentage centrø
            spPct = Instance.new("TextLabel", spFrame)
            spPct.Name = "PercentLabel"
            spPct.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            spPct.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            spPct.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            spPct.Text = "0%"
            spPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            spPct.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            spPct.TextSize = 14
            spPct.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
            spPct.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            spPct.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            spPct.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
            spPct.ZIndex = 304

            -- Bouton invisible pour drag
            local spToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", spFrame)
            spToggleBtn.Name = "ToggleGUIBtn"
            spToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            spToggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            spToggleBtn.Text = ""
            spToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            spToggleBtn.ZIndex = 310

            local _spWasDragged = false
            spToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
                if _spWasDragged then return end
                local base = spFrame.Size
                TS:Create(spFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {
                    Size = UDim2.new(base.X.Scale, base.X.Offset * 0.97, base.Y.Scale, base.Y.Offset * 0.92)
                }):Play()
                task.delay(0.1, function()
                    TS:Create(spFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Size = base }):Play()
                end)
            end)

            -- Update : 0% / 100% + nom
            local _renderConn
            _renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not container or not container.Parent or not container.Visible then return end

                local canSteal = Steal.AutoStealEnabled and findNearestPrompt() ~= nil
                local pct = canSteal and 1 or 0

                if isStealing and stealStartTime then
                    pct = math.clamp((tick() - stealStartTime) / 0.2, 0, 1)
                end

                spFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)

                if pct >= 0.99 then
                    spPct.Text = "100%"
                else
                    spPct.Text = "0%"
                end

                -- Nom + $/s au-dessus
                if currentTargetInfo.name ~= "" then
                    local moneyStr = currentTargetInfo.money
                    if moneyStr == "" then
                        nameLabel.Text = currentTargetInfo.name
                    else
                        if not moneyStr:find("%$") then
                            moneyStr = "$" .. moneyStr
                        end
                        if not moneyStr:find("/s") then
                            moneyStr = moneyStr .. "/s"
                        end
                        nameLabel.Text = currentTargetInfo.name .. " - " .. moneyStr
                    end
                    nameLabel.Visible = true
                else
                    nameLabel.Text = ""
                    nameLabel.Visible = false
                end
            end)

            -- Drag
            local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
            spToggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = true
                    _spWasDragged = false
                    dragStart = inp.Position
                    startPos = container.Position
                    inp.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                            dragging = false
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
                if not dragging then return end
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    local dx = inp.Position.X - dragStart.X
                    local dy = inp.Position.Y - dragStart.Y
                    if math.abs(dx) > 5 or math.abs(dy) > 5 then
                        _spWasDragged = true
                    end
                    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000, 1000)
                    local sz = container.AbsoluteSize
                    local newXScalePx = startPos.X.Scale * vp.X
                    local newX = math.clamp(newXScalePx + startPos.X.Offset + dx, sz.X / 2, vp.X - sz.X / 2)
                    local newY = math.clamp(startPos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + startPos.Y.Offset + dy, sz.Y, vp.Y)
                    container.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, newX - newXScalePx, startPos.Y.Scale, newY - startPos.Y.Scale * vp.Y)
                end
            end)

            _G._CursedSetProgressBarVisible = function(v)
                if container then container.Visible = v end
            end
            _G._KiroProgressBar = {
                frame = container,
                fill = spFill,
                pct = spPct,
                title = nameLabel,
                setVisible = function(v) if container then container.Visible = v end end,
            }

            table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
                pcall(function() if _renderConn then _renderConn:Disconnect() end end)
                pcall(function() if spScreenGui then spScreenGui:Destroy() end end)
            end)
        end

        -- Auto steal always on
        Steal.AutoStealEnabled = true
        pcall(startAutoSteal)

        -- ============================================================
        -- ANTI-DIE ?" ALWAYS ENABLED
        -- ============================================================
        do
            local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
            local connections = {}

            local function enableAntiDie()
                local char = LP.Character
                if not char then return end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return end

                local healthConn = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                    if hum.Health <= 0 then
                        hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(connections, healthConn)

                local diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
                    task.wait()
                    pcall(function()
                        local newHum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
                        newHum.Name = "Humanoid"
                        newHum.Parent = char
                        if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                            Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = newHum
                        end
                        hum:Destroy()
                    end)
                end)
                table.insert(connections, diedConn)
            end

            local function setup()
                for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
                    pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                end
                connections = {}
                enableAntiDie()
            end

            setup()
            LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.1)
                setup()
            end)
        end

        _G._KiroStartAutoSteal = startAutoSteal
        _G._KiroStopAutoSteal = stopAutoSteal
        _G._KiroSetGiantPotion = function(s) giantPotionEnabled = s and true or false end
        _G._KiroIsMyPlotByName = isMyPlotByName
        _G._KiroIsValidStealPrompt = isValidStealPrompt
        _G._KiroFindNearestPrompt = function()
            local p = findNearestPrompt()
            return p
        end
    end)()
    local Steal = _G.AutoSteal
    local function startAutoSteal(...) return _G._KiroStartAutoSteal(...) end
    local function stopAutoSteal(...) return _G._KiroStopAutoSteal(...) end
    local function isMyPlotByName(...) return _G._KiroIsMyPlotByName(...) end
    local function isValidStealPrompt(...) return _G._KiroIsValidStealPrompt(...) end
    local function findNearestPrompt(...) return _G._KiroFindNearestPrompt(...) end

    _G.AutoBigPotion = (function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer

    local POTION_RADIUS = 5

    local Core = {
        enabled = false,
        _sessionTokens = {},
        _potionNames = {"Giant Potion", "Giant", "Grow Potion", "Super Grow", "Potion"},
        _giantThreshold = 2.5,
        _stealAttrs = {"Stealing", "steal", "stolen", "isStealing", "IsSteal", "issteal"},
        _connections = {},
        _lastActivate = 0,
        _radius = POTION_RADIUS,
    }

    function Core:isGiant()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end
        local scale = hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale")
            or hum:FindFirstChild("BodyDepthScale")
            or hum:FindFirstChild("BodyWidthScale")
        return scale and scale:IsA("NumberValue") and scale.Value >= self._giantThreshold
    end

    function Core:isStealActive()
        for _, attr in ipairs(self._stealAttrs) do
            local success, value = pcall(function()
                return player:GetAttribute(attr)
            end)
            if success and value ~= nil and value ~= false and value ~= 0 then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    function Core:getPromptWorldPos(prompt)
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return nil end
        local pp = prompt.Parent
        if pp:IsA("Attachment") then return pp.WorldPosition end
        if pp:IsA("BasePart") then return pp.Position end
        local part = pp:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if part then return part.Position end
        return nil
    end

    function Core:distanceToPrompt(prompt)
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return math.huge end
        local pos = self:getPromptWorldPos(prompt)
        if not pos then return math.huge end
        return (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
    end

    function Core:isNearPrompt(prompt, radius)
        radius = radius or self._radius or POTION_RADIUS
        return self:distanceToPrompt(prompt) <= radius
    end

    function Core:isInEnemyPlot()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return false end
        local myName = player.Name:lower()
        local myDisplay = player.DisplayName:lower()
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if sign then
                local label = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                if label then
                    local t = label.Text:lower()
                    if not (t:find(myName, 1, true) or t:find(myDisplay, 1, true)) then
                        local hitbox = plot:FindFirstChild("StealHitbox", true)
                        if hitbox then
                            local cf, size = hitbox.CFrame, hitbox.Size
                            local hx, hz = size.X * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                            local rel = cf:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
                            if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    function Core:findPotion()
        local char = player.Character
        local bp = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if not char or not bp then return nil end
        for _, name in ipairs(self._potionNames) do
            local potion = bp:FindFirstChild(name) or char:FindFirstChild(name)
            if potion and potion:IsA("Tool") then
                return potion
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Core:isStealPrompt(prompt)
        if not prompt then return false end
        local at = tostring(prompt.ActionText or "")
        local st = nil
        pcall(function() st = prompt:GetAttribute("State") end)
        if at == "Steal" or at == "Grab" then return true end
        if st == "Steal" or st == "Grab" then return true end
        return false
    end

    function Core:activate(force, prompt)
        if self:isGiant() then return false end
        local now = tick()
        if now - (self._lastActivate or 0) < 0.75 then return false end

        if prompt then
            if not self:isNearPrompt(prompt, self._radius) then
                return false
            end
        else
            if not force and not self:isInEnemyPlot() then
                return false
            end
        end

        local char = player.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local bp = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if not char or not hum or not bp then return false end
        local potion = self:findPotion()
        if not potion then return false end

        local success = pcall(function()
            if potion.Parent ~= char then
                hum:EquipTool(potion)
            end
            potion:Activate()
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                if potion and potion.Parent == char and bp and bp.Parent then
                    pcall(function() potion.Parent = bp end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if success then
            self._lastActivate = now
        end
        return success and true or false
    end

    function Core:forceActivate(prompt)
        return self:activate(true, prompt)
    end

    function Core:clearSession()
        for k in next, self._sessionTokens do
            self._sessionTokens[k] = nil
        end
    end

    function Core:cleanup()
        for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        self._connections = {}
        self:clearSession()
    end

    function Core:start()
        if #self._connections > 0 then return end

        local holdConn = ProximityPromptService.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr ~= player or not self.enabled then return end
            if not self:isStealPrompt(prompt) then return end
            if self:isGiant() then return end
            local myToken = {}
            self._sessionTokens[prompt] = myToken
            local dur = (prompt.HoldDuration and prompt.HoldDuration > 0) and prompt.HoldDuration or 1
            task.delay(dur * 0.99, function()
                if self._sessionTokens[prompt] ~= myToken or not self.enabled then return end
                if not (prompt and prompt.Parent) then return end
                if self:isNearPrompt(prompt, self._radius) then
                    self:activate(false, prompt)
                end
            end)
        end)
        table.insert(self._connections, holdConn)

        local holdEndConn = ProximityPromptService.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr == player then self._sessionTokens[prompt] = nil end
        end)
        table.insert(self._connections, holdEndConn)

        local triggeredConn = ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr ~= player then return end
            self._sessionTokens[prompt] = nil
            if not self.enabled then return end
            if not self:isStealPrompt(prompt) then return end
            if self:isGiant() then return end
            task.defer(function()
                if not self.enabled then return end
                if self:isNearPrompt(prompt, self._radius) then
                    self:activate(true, prompt)
                end
            end)
        end)
        table.insert(self._connections, triggeredConn)
    end

    function Core:stop()
        self:cleanup()
    end

    function Core:set(state)
        self.enabled = state and true or false
        pcall(function()
            _G.giantPotionEnabled = self.enabled
            pcall(function() if _G._KiroSetGiantPotion then _G._KiroSetGiantPotion(self.enabled) end end)
        end)
        if self.enabled then
            self:start()
        else
            self:stop()
        end
    end

    local M = {}
    function M.set(state)
        state = state and true or false
        Core:set(state)
        pcall(function()
            if Config and Config.set then
                Config.set("auto_giant_potion", state and true or false)
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
            end
        end)
    end
    function M.isEnabled()
        return Core.enabled
    end
    function M.activate(force, prompt)
        return Core:activate(force, prompt)
    end
    function M.forceActivate(prompt)
        return Core:forceActivate(prompt)
    end
    function M.clearSession()
        return Core:clearSession()
    end
    function M.setRadius(r)
        Core._radius = tonumber(r) or POTION_RADIUS
    end
    M._core = Core
    _G.AutoPotionSystem = Core
    _G.AutoBigPotion = M
    return M
end)()

    _G.giantSpeedRequested = false
    _G.GiantPotionSpeed = (function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

        local GPS = { enabled = false, speed = 34, active = false }
        pcall(function()
            if Config then
                local s = tonumber(Config.get("giantPotionSpeed", nil))
                    or tonumber(Config.get("slider:GPS Speed", nil))
                    or 34
                if s then GPS.speed = math.clamp(s, 1, 100) end
            end
        end)

        local _velocity, _attachment, _jumpConn, _loopConn, _charConn
        local _suspendedBooster = false
        local _graceUntil = 0
        local _paused = false
        local KEYWORDS = { "giant", "big", "grow", "size", "large", "mega", "huge", "potion" }

        local function getBooster()
            return rawget(_G, "Booster") or (type(Booster) == "table" and Booster) or nil
        end

        local function isGiantKeyword(str)
            if not str then return false end
            local low = string.lower(tostring(str))
            for _, k in ipairs(KEYWORDS) do
                if low:find(k, 1, true) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function getAvgScale(char)
            if not char then return 1 end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return 1 end
            local sum, n = 0, 0
            for _, name in ipairs({ "BodyHeightScale", "BodyDepthScale", "BodyWidthScale", "BodyProportionScale" }) do
                local v = hum:FindFirstChild(name)
                if v and v:IsA("NumberValue") then
                    sum = sum + v.Value
                    n = n + 1
                end
            end
            return n > 0 and (sum / n) or 1
        end

        local function hasGiantAttribute(inst)
            if not inst then return false end
            local ok, attrs = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttributes() end)
            if not ok or type(attrs) ~= "table" then return false end
            for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
                if isGiantKeyword(k) then
                    if v == true then return true end
                    if type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return true end
                    if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" and v ~= "0" and string.lower(v) ~= "false" and string.lower(v) ~= "none" then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function isGiantNow()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return false end
            if os.clock() < _graceUntil then return true end
            if getAvgScale(char) >= 2.0 then return true end
            if hasGiantAttribute(char) then return true end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hasGiantAttribute(hum) then return true end
            if hasGiantAttribute(LocalPlayer) then return true end
            for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and isGiantKeyword(t.Name) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function Cleanup()
            if _velocity then pcall(function() _velocity:Destroy() end) _velocity = nil end
            if _attachment then pcall(function() _attachment:Destroy() end) _attachment = nil end
            if _jumpConn then pcall(function() _jumpConn:Disconnect() end) _jumpConn = nil end
            if _suspendedBooster then
                _suspendedBooster = false
                local B = getBooster()
                if B and B.unsuspend then
                    pcall(function() B.unsuspend("gps") end)
                end
            end
            GPS.active = false
            _G.KiroGPSEnabled = false
            _G.GammaGPSEnabled = false
        end

        local function CreateVelocity(hrp)
            if _velocity then pcall(function() _velocity:Destroy() end) end
            if _attachment then pcall(function() _attachment:Destroy() end) end
            _attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
            _attachment.Name = "KiroGPSAtt"
            _attachment.Parent = hrp
            _velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
            _velocity.Name = "KiroGPSLV"
            _velocity.Parent = _attachment
            _velocity.Attachment0 = _attachment
            _velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            _velocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
            _velocity.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            _velocity.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
            _velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            _velocity.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, 0, math.huge)
            _velocity.Enabled = true
        end

        local function SetupJump(hrp, humanoid)
            if _jumpConn then _jumpConn:Disconnect() _jumpConn = nil end
            _jumpConn = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
                if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and GPS.enabled and GPS.active then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
                        GPS.speed,
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
                    )
                end
            end)
        end

        local function StartActiveLoop()
            if _loopConn or _paused then return end
            _G.KiroGPSEnabled = true
            _G.GammaGPSEnabled = true
            _loopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not GPS.enabled or _paused or _G._KiroSemiTPActive then
                    if _velocity then
                        _velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                        _velocity.Enabled = false
                    end
                    if not GPS.enabled or _paused then
                        Cleanup()
                        if _loopConn then _loopConn:Disconnect() _loopConn = nil end
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not isGiantNow() then
                    Cleanup()
                    return
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then return end
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not (humanoid and hrp) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
                if not (_velocity and _attachment and _attachment.Parent == hrp) then
                    CreateVelocity(hrp)
                end
                if not _jumpConn then SetupJump(hrp, humanoid) end
                local B = getBooster()
                if B and B.enabled and not _suspendedBooster then
                    _suspendedBooster = true
                    pcall(function() B.suspend("gps") end)
                end
                GPS.active = true
                local md = humanoid.MoveDirection
                if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                    local unit = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z)
                    if unit.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        unit = unit.Unit
                        _velocity.Enabled = true
                        _velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(unit.X * GPS.speed, unit.Z * GPS.speed)
                    end
                else
                    if _velocity then _velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(0, 0) end
                end
            end)
        end

        local function StopActiveLoop()
            if _loopConn then _loopConn:Disconnect() _loopConn = nil end
            Cleanup()
        end

        local function onBecameGiant()
            _graceUntil = os.clock() + 1.25
            if GPS.enabled and not _paused then StartActiveLoop() end
        end

        local function watchCharacter(char)
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                for _, name in ipairs({ "BodyHeightScale", "BodyDepthScale", "BodyWidthScale" }) do
                    local v = hum:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if v and v:IsA("NumberValue") then
                        v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
                            if v.Value >= 2.0 then onBecameGiant() end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                hum.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c:IsA("NumberValue") and (c.Name == "BodyHeightScale" or c.Name == "BodyDepthScale" or c.Name == "BodyWidthScale") then
                        c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
                            if c.Value >= 2.0 then onBecameGiant() end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                if c:IsA("Tool") and isGiantKeyword(c.Name) then onBecameGiant() end
            end)
            if isGiantNow() then onBecameGiant() end
        end

        function GPS.set(on, skipSave)
            on = on and true or false
            GPS.enabled = on
            _G.giantSpeedRequested = on
            if on then
                if not _charConn then
                    _charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                        StopActiveLoop()
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        if GPS.enabled and not _paused then watchCharacter(c) end
                    end)
                end
                if LocalPlayer.Character and not _paused then
                    watchCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
                end
                if isGiantNow() and not _paused then StartActiveLoop() end
            else
                StopActiveLoop()
            end
            -- Persist only when user toggles (same as Auto Steal). Teardown uses skipSave=true.
            if not skipSave then
                pcall(function()
                    if setToggleSaved then
                        setToggleSaved("Giant Potion Speed", on)
                    elseif Config then
                        Config.set("toggle:Giant Potion Speed", on)
                        local t = Config.get("toggles", {})
                        if type(t) ~= "table" then t = {} end
                        t["Giant Potion Speed"] = on
                        Config.set("toggles", t)
                        if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                        if Config.save then Config.save() end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        function GPS.pause()
            if _paused then return end
            _paused = true
            StopActiveLoop()
        end

        function GPS.resume()
            if not _paused then return end
            _paused = false
            if GPS.enabled then
                if LocalPlayer.Character then watchCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end
                if isGiantNow() then StartActiveLoop() end
            end
        end

        function GPS.setSpeed(val)
            val = tonumber(val) or GPS.speed
            GPS.speed = math.clamp(val, 1, 100)
            -- Apply live while boost is active
            pcall(function()
                if _velocity and _velocity.Parent and GPS.active and GPS.enabled then
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        local md = hum.MoveDirection
                        if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                            local unit = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z)
                            if unit.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                                unit = unit.Unit
                                _velocity.Enabled = true
                                _velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(unit.X * GPS.speed, unit.Z * GPS.speed)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if Config then
                    Config.set("giantPotionSpeed", GPS.speed)
                    Config.set("slider:GPS Speed", GPS.speed)
                end
            end)
        end

        function GPS.isActive() return GPS.active end
        function GPS.getSpeed() return GPS.speed end
        GPS.isGiant = isGiantNow
        _G.isPlayerGiant = isGiantNow

        return GPS
    end)()
    table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.GiantPotionSpeed and _G.GiantPotionSpeed.set then
                -- skipSave: do not overwrite saved toggle (same as Auto Steal)
                _G.GiantPotionSpeed.set(false, true)
            end
        end)
    end)

            }

        local function formatMoney(n)
            if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
            local abs = math.abs(n)
            if abs >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.1fT", n / 1e12):gsub("%.0T", "T")
            elseif abs >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", n / 1e9):gsub("%.0B", "B")
            elseif abs >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", n / 1e6):gsub("%.0M", "M")
            elseif abs >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3):gsub("%.0K", "K")
            else return tostring(math.floor(n + 0.5)) end
        end
