                    setToggleSafe(name, want, false)
                end
                M._saved = {}
                M._savedDuel = {}
            end
            pcall(function()
                if setToggleSaved then setToggleSaved("Kiro Hub All Gear", on) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if Config then
                    Config.set("kiro_hub_all_gear", on)
                    if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                end
            end)
            -- Banner title: KIRO HUB vs KIRO HUB ALL GEAR
            pcall(function()
                if type(_G._KiroUpdateBannerTitle) == "function" then
                    _G._KiroUpdateBannerTitle(on)
                elseif _G._KiroBannerTitle and _G._KiroBannerTitle.Parent then
                    if on then
                        _G._KiroBannerTitle.Text = "KIRO HUB ALL GEAR"
                        _G._KiroBannerTitle.TextSize = 16
                    else
                        _G._KiroBannerTitle.Text = "KIRO HUB"
                        _G._KiroBannerTitle.TextSize = 20
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(0.75)
                if M.enabled then
                    pcall(forceCloseGearGuis)
                    pcall(function() applyToggleCardsVisibility(true) end)
                    pcall(function() applyEmptySections(true) end)
                    pcall(function() applyRagdollVisibility(true) end)
                    pcall(function() applyDuelVisibility(true) end)
                else
                    pcall(function() applyDuelVisibility(false) end)
                end
            end
        end)

        -- hide Duel by default until All Gear is turned on
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(0.4)
            if not M.enabled then
                pcall(function() applyDuelVisibility(false) end)
            end
        end)

        table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
            pcall(function()
                if M.enabled then
                    applyToggleCardsVisibility(false)
                    applyEmptySections(false)
                    applyRagdollVisibility(false)
                    M.enabled = false
                end
            end)
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    local FONTS_LIST = {
        { name = "Gotham Bold",   enum = Enum.Font.GothamBold },
        { name = "Gotham",        enum = Enum.Font.Gotham },
        { name = "Gotham Black",  enum = Enum.Font.GothamBlack },
        { name = "Source Sans",   enum = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold },
        { name = "Fredoka One",   enum = Enum.Font.FredokaOne },
        { name = "Cartoon",       enum = Enum.Font.Cartoon },
        { name = "Arcade",        enum = Enum.Font.Arcade },
        { name = "Code",          enum = Enum.Font.Code },
        { name = "Sci-Fi",        enum = Enum.Font.SciFi },
        { name = "Fantasy",       enum = Enum.Font.Fantasy },
        { name = "Highway",       enum = Enum.Font.Highway },
    }

    local function fontByName(n)
        for _, f in ipairs(FONTS_LIST) do
            if f.name == n then return f.enum end
        end
        return Enum.Font.GothamBold
    end

    local function applyFontEverywhere(fontEnum)
        if not fontEnum then return end
        local targets = {}
        pcall(function()
            if GUI then table.insert(targets, GUI) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                local h = gethui()
                if h then table.insert(targets, h) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(targets, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            table.insert(targets, game:GetService("CoreGui"))
        end)
        local seen = {}
        for _, root in ipairs(targets) do
            if root and not seen[root] then
                seen[root] = true
                pcall(function()
                    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                            local n = ""
                            pcall(function()
                                local sg = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
                                n = sg and sg.Name or ""
                            end)
                            if n == "KiroHub" or n == "KiroHub" or n:find("PanelGui_") or n == "StealProgressScreenGui"
                                or n == "KiroHubReopen" or n == "KiroLabelGui" or n == "KiroHubBanner"
                                or n == "KiroHubReopen" or n == "KiroLabelGui" then
                                pcall(function() d.Font = fontEnum end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    _G._KiroApplyHubFont = applyFontEverywhere

    local _savedFontName = "Gotham Bold"
    pcall(function()
        if Config then
            _savedFontName = Config.get("hubFont", "Gotham Bold") or "Gotham Bold"
        end
    end)
    _G.KiroHubSelectedFont = _savedFontName

    local function selectHubFont(name)
        if not name then return end
        _G.KiroHubSelectedFont = name
        pcall(function()
            if Config then Config.set("hubFont", name) end
        end)
        applyFontEverywhere(fontByName(name))
    end
    _G._KiroSelectHubFont = selectHubFont

    end)

    -- Gummy Bypass: clear BlockTools/Web + delete GummyBear
    _G.GummyBypass = (function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

        local M = { enabled = false }
        local antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil = 0
        local childAddedConn = nil
        local charAddedConn = nil
        local loopRunning = false

        local function clearGummyToolBlockState(char)
            if not char then return end
            pcall(function()
                for _, inst in ipairs({ Player, char }) do
                    if inst then
                        if inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools") ~= nil then
                            inst:SetAttribute("BlockTools", false)
                        end
                        if inst:GetAttribute("Web") ~= nil then
                            inst:SetAttribute("Web", false)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if char:GetAttribute("BackpackReady") == false then
                    char:SetAttribute("BackpackReady", true)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function deleteGummyBears()
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj.Name == "GummyBear" then
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function stopLoops()
            loopRunning = false
            if childAddedConn then
                pcall(function() childAddedConn:Disconnect() end)
                childAddedConn = nil
            end
            if charAddedConn then
                pcall(function() charAddedConn:Disconnect() end)
                charAddedConn = nil
            end
        end

        local function startLoops()
            stopLoops()
            loopRunning = true

            charAddedConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil = tick() + 1.5
            end)

            childAddedConn = Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if M.enabled and child.Name == "GummyBear" then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                while loopRunning and M.enabled do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if not M.enabled then break end
                    local char = Player.Character
                    if char and tick() >= antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil then
                        clearGummyToolBlockState(char)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.set(on)
            on = on and true or false
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                deleteGummyBears()
                startLoops()
            else
                stopLoops()
            end
            -- Save is handled by Toggle() via setToggleSaved (same as Auto Steal)
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
            pcall(function()
                if M.set then M.set(false) end
            end)
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    -- PaintBall Bypass: block PaintballHitted UseItem OnClientEvent (Anti Paintball)
    _G.PaintBallBypass = (function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

        local M = {
            enabled = false,
            remote = nil,
            disabledConns = {},
        }

        local function resolveUseItemRemote()
            if M.remote and M.remote.Parent then
                return M.remote
            end
            M.remote = nil

            -- Prefer hub resolver if available
            if type(_G._FH_ResolveUseItemRemote) == "function" then
                local ok, r = pcall(_G._FH_ResolveUseItemRemote)
                if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    M.remote = r
                    return r
                end
            end

            -- Aimbot cache if present
            pcall(function()
                if Aimbot and type(Aimbot.findUseItemOnce) == "function" then
                    local r = Aimbot.findUseItemOnce()
                    if typeof(r) == "Instance" and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        M.remote = r
                    end
                end
            end)
            if M.remote then return M.remote end

            local ok, netFolder = pcall(function()
                return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages", 8):WaitForChild("Net", 8)
            end)
            if not ok or not netFolder then return nil end

            local getconns = (type(getconnections) == "function") and getconnections or nil
            local getconsts = (debug and type(debug.getconstants) == "function") and debug.getconstants
                or ((type(getconstants) == "function") and getconstants or nil)

            if getconns and getconsts then
                for _, r in ipairs(netFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        local okC, conns = pcall(getconns, r.OnClientEvent)
                        if okC and type(conns) == "table" then
                            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                                if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                                    local okK, consts = pcall(getconsts, c.Function)
                                    if okK and type(consts) == "table" then
                                        for _, k in ipairs(consts) do
                                            if k == "PaintballHitted" then
                                                M.remote = r
                                                return r
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Fallback by name
            for _, r in ipairs(netFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and tostring(r.Name):find("UseItem", 1, true) then
                    M.remote = r
                    return r
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function disableRemoteConns(remote)
            M.disabledConns = {}
            if not remote or type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return 0 end
            local n = 0
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, remote.OnClientEvent)
            if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
                for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
                    local disabled = false
                    pcall(function()
                        if conn.Function and conn.Disable then
                            conn:Disable()
                            disabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                    if not disabled then
                        pcall(function()
                            if conn.Disable then conn:Disable() disabled = true end
                        end)
                    end
                    if disabled then
                        table.insert(M.disabledConns, conn)
                        n = n + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            return n
        end

        local function enableRemoteConns()
            for _, conn in ipairs(M.disabledConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    if conn.Enable then conn:Enable() end
                end)
            end
            M.disabledConns = {}
        end

        local function enableAntiPaintball()
            task.spawn(function()
                local remote = resolveUseItemRemote()
                if remote then
                    local n = disableRemoteConns(remote)
                    pcall(function()
                        if showToast then
                            showToast("PaintBall Bypass ON (" .. tostring(n) .. ")", true)
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    pcall(function()
                        if showToast then
                            showToast("PaintBall remote not found", false)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function disableAntiPaintball()
            enableRemoteConns()
        end

        function M.set(on, skipSave)
            on = on and true or false
            if on == M.enabled then
                if on then enableAntiPaintball() end
                return
            end
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                enableAntiPaintball()
            else
                disableAntiPaintball()
            end
            if not skipSave then
                pcall(function()
                    if setToggleSaved then
                        setToggleSaved("PaintBall Bypass", on)
                    elseif Config then
                        Config.set("toggle:PaintBall Bypass", on)
                        local t = Config.get("toggles", {})
                        if type(t) ~= "table" then t = {} end
                        t["PaintBall Bypass"] = on
                        Config.set("toggles", t)
                        if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                        if Config.save then Config.save() end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
            pcall(function()
                -- skipSave: do not overwrite saved toggle (same as Auto Steal)
                if M.set then M.set(false, true) end
            end)
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    -- Quick Grab: réduit HoldDuration des prompts sur TA base (0.1s)
    _G.QuickGrab = (function()
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
        local enabled = false
        local orig = {}
        local hooked = false

        local function isMyPlot(plot)
            if not plot or not plot:IsA("Model") then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            return sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase") and sign.YourBase.Enabled
        end

        local function inMyPlot(inst)
            if not inst or not inst.Parent then return false end
            local node = inst.Parent
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not node then return false end
                if node:IsA("Model") and node.Parent and node.Parent.Name == "Plots" then
                    return isMyPlot(node)
                end
                node = node.Parent
            end
            return false
        end

        local function installHook()
            if hooked then return end
            local ok, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, game)
            if not ok or not mt then return end
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, false)
            local oldNewIndex = mt.__newindex
            local nc = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
            mt.__newindex = nc(function(self, key, value)
                if key == "HoldDuration"
                   and enabled
                   and typeof(self) == "Instance"
                   and self:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                   and inMyPlot(self) then
                    value = 0.1
                end
                return oldNewIndex(self, key, value)
            end)
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, true)
            hooked = true
        end

        local function applyAll()
            local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") or Workspace
            local stack = { root }
            local visited = 0
            while #stack > 0 do
                if not enabled then return end
                local cur = table.remove(stack)
                for _, d in ipairs(cur:GetChildren()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inMyPlot(d) then
                        if orig[d] == nil then orig[d] = d.HoldDuration end
                        pcall(function() d.HoldDuration = 0.1 end)
                    end
                    table.insert(stack, d)
                end
                visited = visited + 1
                if visited % 50 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end

        local M = {}
        function M.set(v)
            enabled = v and true or false
            if enabled then
                installHook()
                task.spawn(applyAll)
            else
                for p, o in pairs(orig) do
                    if p and p.Parent then pcall(function() p.HoldDuration = o end) end
                end
                orig = {}
            end
        end
        function M.isEnabled()
            return enabled
        end
        return M
    end)()

    table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.QuickGrab and _G.QuickGrab.set then
                _G.QuickGrab.set(false)
            end
        end)
    end)

    _G.AllowFriends = (function()
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
        local M = {
            enabled = false,
            gui = nil,
            btn = nil,
            isDisallowed = false,
            cooldown = false,
        }

        local function colPrimary()
            if Theme and typeof(Theme.c1) == "Color3" then return Theme.c1 end
            return Color3.fromRGB(235, 45, 55)
        end
        local function colDeep()
            if T and typeof(T.BgDeep) == "Color3" then return T.BgDeep end
            return Color3.fromRGB(8, 6, 14)
        end
        local function colText()
            if T and typeof(T.Text) == "Color3" then return T.Text end
            return Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 255)
        end

        local function fireAllFriendPanels()
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return 0 end
            local count = 0
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local friendPanel = plot:FindFirstChild("FriendPanel", true)
                if friendPanel then
                    local main = friendPanel:FindFirstChild("Main")
                    local root = main or friendPanel
                    for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                            pcall(function()
                                if fireproximityprompt then
                                    fireproximityprompt(obj)
                                end
                            end)
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return count
        end

        local function paintBtn()
            if not M.btn then return end
            local primary = colPrimary()
            if M.isDisallowed then
                M.btn.Text = "Disallow Friends"
                M.btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 50)
                pcall(function()
                    local s = M.btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) end
                end)
            else
                M.btn.Text = "Allow Friends"
                M.btn.BackgroundColor3 = primary
                pcall(function()
                    local s = M.btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) end
                end)
            end
            local lum = 0.299 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.R + 0.587 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.G + 0.114 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.B
            M.btn.TextColor3 = (lum > 0.55) and Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 22) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end

        local function build()
            if M.gui and M.gui.Parent then return end
            pcall(function()
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local old = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("AllowFriendsGui")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                    local h = gethui()
                    local old = h and h:FindFirstChild("AllowFriendsGui")
                    if old then old:Destroy() end
                end
            end)

            local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            gui.Name = "AllowFriendsGui"
            gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            gui.DisplayOrder = 250
            gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            gui.Enabled = false
            M.gui = gui

            local parented = false
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                    gui.Parent = gethui()
                    parented = gui.Parent ~= nil
                end
            end)
            if not parented then
                pcall(function()
                    gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
                    parented = gui.Parent ~= nil
                end)
            end
            if not parented then
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
                if pg then gui.Parent = pg end
            end

            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Name = "AllowFriendsBtn"
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 168, 0, 40)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -180, 0, 12)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = colPrimary()
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Text = "Allow Friends"
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            btn.TextSize = 13
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 22)
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.Active = true
            btn.ZIndex = 10
            btn.Parent = gui
            M.btn = btn
            do
                local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                c.Parent = btn
            end
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            stroke.Thickness = 1.8
            stroke.Transparency = 0.05
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = btn

            local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
            accent.Name = "Accent"
            accent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2)
            accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -6)
            accent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            accent.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75
            accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
            accent.ZIndex = 11
            accent.Parent = btn
            do
                local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                c.Parent = accent
            end

            paintBtn()

            pcall(function()
                if loadGuiPosition and loadGuiPosition("AllowFriendsGui", btn) then return end
                if Config then
                    local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                    local p = positions["AllowFriendsGui"]
                    if type(p) == "table" and #p >= 4 then
                        btn.Position = UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])
                    end
                end
            end)

            local wasDragged = false
            local cooldown = false
            btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                if wasDragged then return end
                if cooldown then return end
                cooldown = true
                M.isDisallowed = not M.isDisallowed
                paintBtn()
                btn.TextTransparency = 0.45
                local n = fireAllFriendPanels()
                pcall(function()
                    if showToast then
                        showToast(M.isDisallowed and "Disallow Friends" or "Allow Friends", true)
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(1, function()
                    cooldown = false
                    if btn and btn.Parent then btn.TextTransparency = 0 end
                end)
            end)

            local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
            local function toV2(p)
                if p == nil then return Vector2.zero end
                if typeof(p) == "Vector2" then return p end
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then return Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) end
                return Vector2.new(tonumber(p.X) or 0, tonumber(p.Y) or 0)
            end
            local function savePos()
                pcall(function()
                    if saveGuiPosition then
                        saveGuiPosition("AllowFriendsGui", btn)
                    end
                    if Config then
                        local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                        if type(positions) ~= "table" then positions = {} end
                        local pos = btn.Position
                        positions["AllowFriendsGui"] = {
                            pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset,
                        }
                        Config.set("positions", positions)
                        if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                    end
                end)
            end
            btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    wasDragged = false
                    dragging = true
                    dragStart = toV2(inp.Position)
                    startPos = btn.Position
                end
            end)
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
                if not dragging then return end
                if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local d = toV2(inp.Position) - dragStart
                if d.Magnitude > 6 then wasDragged = true end
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
                )
            end)
            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
                if not dragging then return end
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = false
                    if wasDragged then savePos() end
                    task.delay(0.05, function() wasDragged = false end)
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.set(on)
            on = on and true or false
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                if not M.gui or not M.gui.Parent then build() end
                if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = true end
                paintBtn()
            else
                if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = false end
            end
            pcall(function()
                if Config then
                    Config.set("allow_friends_visible", on)
                    Config.set("toggle:Allow Friends", on)
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        function M.repaint()
            paintBtn()
        end

        task.defer(function()
            pcall(build)
            if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = false end
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.AllowFriends and _G.AllowFriends.set then
                _G.AllowFriends.set(false)
            end
        end)
    end)

            end

    end

        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0)
        arrow.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        arrow.ZIndex = 5

        headerBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

        local expanded = false

        local function paintCarpetBtns()
            local cur = _G.coreSelectedCarpet or "Flying Carpet"
            selectedLbl.Text = cur
            for name, b in pairs(carpetBtns) do
                if name == cur then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.c1 or T.Primary
                    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                else
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = T.Soft
                    b.TextColor3 = T.Text
                end
            end
        end

        local function setExpanded(on)
            expanded = on and true or false
            listCard.Visible = expanded
            arrow.Text = expanded and "¼" or "º"
            listCard.Size = expanded and UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 160) or UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)
        end

        local function selectCarpet(name)
            if not name then return end
            _G.coreSelectedCarpet = name
            _G.KiroHubSelectedCarpet = name
            _G.KiroHubSelectedCarpet = name
            pcall(function()
                if Config then
                    Config.set("selectedCarpet", name)
                    if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if _G.coreConfig and _G.coreConfig.set then
                    _G.coreConfig:set("selectedCarpet", name)
                end
            end)
            paintCarpetBtns()
            setExpanded(false)
            pcall(function()
                if _G.equipCarpet then
                    _G.equipCarpet()
                elseif _G._KiroEquipCarpet then
                    _G._KiroEquipCarpet()
                end
            end)
        end

            setExpanded(not expanded)
        end)

            b.Parent = listScroll
            Corner(b, 8)
            b.Activated:Connect(function()
                selectCarpet(name)
            end)
            carpetBtns[name] = b
        end
        paintCarpetBtns()
    end

    Button(Utils.scroll, "Reset Gui", "Centre toutes les interfaces", function()
        local function centerGui(obj)
            if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
            if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
            pcall(function()
                obj.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                obj.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
            end)
        end

        local function findNamed(name)
            local found = {}
            local parents = {}
            pcall(function()
                if type(gethui) == "function" then
                    local h = gethui()
                    if h then table.insert(parents, h) end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui"))
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                local pg = lp and (lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
                if pg then table.insert(parents, pg) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if GUI then table.insert(parents, GUI) end
            end)
            for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
                pcall(function()
                    local o = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if o then table.insert(found, o) end
                    for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d.Name == name then
                            table.insert(found, d)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return found
        end

        local function centerScreenGui(sg)
            if not sg then return end
            pcall(function()
                local fr = sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    centerGui(fr)
                    return
                end
                for _, ch in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("Frame") or ch:IsA("ImageLabel") or ch:IsA("TextButton") then
                        centerGui(ch)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            if Root then
                centerGui(Root)
            end
        end)

        -- Ne pas reset la position du bouton KIRO (ReopenBtn) : on le laisse où il est

        local panelNames = {
            "PanelGui_Actions",
            "PanelGui_ActionsMobile",
            "PanelGui_KiroQuickPanel",
            "PanelGui_Kiro Admin Spammer",
            "PanelGui_Command Cooldowns",
            "PanelGui_Booster",
            "PanelGui_Kiro Defense",
            "PanelGui_Defense",
            "PanelGui_Kiro Defense",
            "PanelGui_Instant Steal V2",
            "PanelGui_StealTarget",
            "PanelGui_Admin Panel",
        }
        for _, name in ipairs(panelNames) do
            for _, obj in ipairs(findNamed(name)) do
                if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    centerScreenGui(obj)
                elseif obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    centerGui(obj)
                end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            if Config then
                -- Préserve la position du bouton KIRO si elle existe dans positions
                local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                local reopenPos = nil
                if type(positions) == "table" then
                    reopenPos = positions["KiroHubReopen"] or positions["KiroReopenBtn"] or positions["reopen"]
                end
                local savedReopen = Config.get("reopen_pos", nil)

                Config.set("positions", {})
                if reopenPos then
                    local newPos = {}
                    newPos["KiroHubReopen"] = reopenPos
                    if positions["KiroReopenBtn"] then newPos["KiroReopenBtn"] = positions["KiroReopenBtn"] end
                    Config.set("positions", newPos)
                end
                -- Ne pas effacer reopen_pos
                if savedReopen ~= nil then
                    Config.set("reopen_pos", savedReopen)
                end
                Config.set("root_pos", nil)
                Config.set("actions_panel_pos", nil)
                Config.set("isv2_panel_pos", nil)
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if showToast then showToast("GUI reset (center)", true) end
        end)
    end)

    local function makeConfigCard(order, titleText, descText, btnText, btnWidth, onClick)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = titleText:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Card"
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 58)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 12, 18)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.LayoutOrder = order
        card.Parent = ConfigTab.scroll

        do
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            c.Parent = card

            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Thickness = 1
            s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 50, 40)
            s.Transparency = 0.6
            s.Parent = card
        end

        local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(btnWidth + 24), 0, 20)
        titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 10)
        titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        titleLbl.Text = titleText
        titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        titleLbl.TextSize = 14
        titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        titleLbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        titleLbl.ZIndex = 5
        titleLbl.Parent = card

        local descLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        descLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(btnWidth + 24), 0, 16)
        descLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 31)
        descLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        descLbl.Text = descText
        descLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        descLbl.TextSize = 11
        descLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 160, 175)
        descLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        descLbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        descLbl.ZIndex = 5
        descLbl.Parent = card

        local actionBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        actionBtn.Name = "ActionBtn"
        actionBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(btnWidth, 34)
        actionBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(btnWidth + 12), 0.5, -17)
        actionBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 30, 40) -- Bright Red matching photo
        actionBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        actionBtn.Text = btnText
        actionBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        actionBtn.TextSize = 13
        actionBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        actionBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        actionBtn.ZIndex = 6
        actionBtn.Parent = card

        local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) -- Smooth capsule pill matching photo
        btnCorner.Parent = actionBtn

        local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        btnStroke.Thickness = 1
        btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70)
        btnStroke.Transparency = 0.4
        btnStroke.Parent = actionBtn

        -- Requested Hover effect:
        -- "quand on selectionnner la souris sur un bouton il devient noir avec le texte en blanc"
        actionBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(actionBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 14),
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 30, 40),
                Transparency = 0,
            }):Play()
        end)
        actionBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(actionBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 30, 40),
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70),
                Transparency = 0.4,
            }):Play()
        end)

        actionBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(actionBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 30)
            }):Play()
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                if actionBtn and actionBtn.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(actionBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 14)
                    }):Play()
                end
            end)
            if onClick then task.spawn(onClick) end
        end)

        return card
    end

    local function applyConfigLive(data)
        if type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
        if type(data.data) == "table" then data = data.data end
        if type(data.config) == "table" then data = data.config end

        -- 1. Extract toggles map
        local togglesMap = {}
        if type(data.toggles) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(data.toggles) do
                togglesMap[tostring(k)] = (v and true or false)
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(data) do
            if type(k) == "string" and k:sub(1, 7) == "toggle:" then
                local tName = k:sub(8)
                if tName ~= "" and togglesMap[tName] == nil then
                    togglesMap[tName] = (v and true or false)
                end
            elseif type(v) == "boolean" and k ~= "_dirty" then
                if togglesMap[k] == nil then
                    togglesMap[k] = v
                end
            end
        end

        -- Map panel visibility booleans to their corresponding toggles
        if data["booster_on"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Booster"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Booster"] = data["booster_on"] and true or false
        end
        if data["booster_gui_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Booster GUI"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Booster GUI"] = data["booster_gui_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["actions_panel_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Actions Panel"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Actions Panel"] = data["actions_panel_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["actions_panel_mobile_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Actions Panel Mobile"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Actions Panel Mobile"] = data["actions_panel_mobile_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["defense_panel_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Defense Panel"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Defense Panel"] = data["defense_panel_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["quick_admin_panel_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Quick Admin Panel"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Quick Admin Panel"] = data["quick_admin_panel_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["admin_spammer_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Admin Spammer"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Admin Spammer"] = data["admin_spammer_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["command_cooldowns_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Command Cooldowns"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Command Cooldowns"] = data["command_cooldowns_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["isv2_panel_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Instant Steal Panel V2"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Instant Steal Panel V2"] = data["isv2_panel_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["steal_target_panel_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Steal Target"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Steal Target"] = data["steal_target_panel_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["tp_brainrot_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["TP Brainrot"] == nil then
            togglesMap["TP Brainrot"] = data["tp_brainrot_visible"] and true or false
        end
        if data["drop_brainrot_visible"] ~= nil and togglesMap["Drop Brainrot"] == nil then
            togglesMap["Drop Brainrot"] = data["drop_brainrot_visible"] and true or false
        end

        togglesMap["Instant Reset"] = nil
        Config.data["toggle:Instant Reset"] = false

        -- 2. Save directly into Config.data
        if type(Config.data) ~= "table" then Config.data = {} end
        for k, v in pairs(data) do
            Config.data[k] = v
        end
        Config.data["toggles"] = togglesMap
        for name, state in pairs(togglesMap) do
            Config.data["toggle:" .. name] = state
        end
        Config.data["toggle:Instant Reset"] = false
        if Config.data["toggles"] then Config.data["toggles"]["Instant Reset"] = nil end
        Config._dirty = true
        pcall(function()
            if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
            if Config.save then Config.save() end
        end)

        -- Write to file on executor disk
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local enc = HttpService:JSONEncode(Config.data)
            if makefolder then
                if not (isfolder and isfolder("KiroHub")) then makefolder("KiroHub") end
                if not (isfolder and isfolder("KiroHub/Configs")) then makefolder("KiroHub/Configs") end
            end
            if writefile then
                writefile("KiroHub/config.json", enc)
                writefile("KiroHub/Configs/shared.json", enc)
            end
        end)

        -- 3. Live Apply All Toggles in the Hub UI & Callbacks
        local reg = _G._KiroToggleReg or {}
        local cbs = _G._KiroToggleCallbacks or {}

        for name, want in pairs(togglesMap) do
            local ctrl = reg[name]
            if ctrl then
                pcall(function()
                    if ctrl.setState then
                        ctrl.setState(want, true)
                    elseif ctrl.set then
                        ctrl.set(want, true)
                    end
                end)
            else
                local cb = cbs[name]
                if type(cb) == "function" then
                    pcall(cb, want)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 4. Live Apply Modules and Panels
        -- Booster
        if data["booster_spd"] or data["booster_jmp"] then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.Booster then
                    if data["booster_spd"] and _G.Booster.setSpeed then _G.Booster.setSpeed(data["booster_spd"]) end
                    if data["booster_jmp"] and _G.Booster.setJump then _G.Booster.setJump(data["booster_jmp"]) end
                end
            end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Booster"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.Booster and _G.Booster.set then _G.Booster.set(togglesMap["Booster"]) end
            end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Booster GUI"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.BoosterGUI and _G.BoosterGUI.setVisible then _G.BoosterGUI.setVisible(togglesMap["Booster GUI"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Delivery ESP
        local delivState = (togglesMap["Delivery Esp"] ~= nil) and togglesMap["Delivery Esp"] or togglesMap["Delivery ESP"]
        if delivState ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.DeliveryESP and _G.DeliveryESP.set then _G.DeliveryESP.set(delivState) end
            end)
        end

        -- Steal Target
        if togglesMap["Steal Target"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.StealTarget and _G.StealTarget.set then _G.StealTarget.set(togglesMap["Steal Target"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Instant Steal V2
        if togglesMap["Instant Steal Panel V2"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.InstantStealV2 and _G.InstantStealV2.set then _G.InstantStealV2.set(togglesMap["Instant Steal Panel V2"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Actions Panel & Mobile
        if togglesMap["Actions Panel"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.ActionsPanel then
                    if _G.ActionsPanel.setVisible then _G.ActionsPanel.setVisible(togglesMap["Actions Panel"])
                    elseif _G.ActionsPanel.set then _G.ActionsPanel.set(togglesMap["Actions Panel"]) end
                end
            end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Actions Panel Mobile"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.ActionsPanelMobile and _G.ActionsPanelMobile.set then _G.ActionsPanelMobile.set(togglesMap["Actions Panel Mobile"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Defense Panel
        if togglesMap["Defense Panel"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.DefensePanel then
                    if _G.DefensePanel.setVisible then _G.DefensePanel.setVisible(togglesMap["Defense Panel"])
                    elseif _G.DefensePanel.set then _G.DefensePanel.set(togglesMap["Defense Panel"]) end
                end
            end)
        end

        -- Quick Admin Panel
        if togglesMap["Quick Admin Panel"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.QuickAdminPanel and _G.QuickAdminPanel.set then _G.QuickAdminPanel.set(togglesMap["Quick Admin Panel"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Admin Spammer
        if togglesMap["Admin Spammer"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.AdminSpammer and _G.AdminSpammer.set then _G.AdminSpammer.set(togglesMap["Admin Spammer"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Command Cooldowns
        if togglesMap["Command Cooldowns"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.CommandCooldowns and _G.CommandCooldowns.setVisible then _G.CommandCooldowns.setVisible(togglesMap["Command Cooldowns"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- Duel (TP & Drop Brainrot)
        if togglesMap["TP Brainrot"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.TPBrainrot and _G.TPBrainrot.set then _G.TPBrainrot.set(togglesMap["TP Brainrot"]) end
            end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Drop Brainrot"] ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.DropBrainrot and _G.DropBrainrot.set then _G.DropBrainrot.set(togglesMap["Drop Brainrot"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- ESP Modules
        if togglesMap["Brainrot ESP"] ~= nil and _G.BrainrotESP and _G.BrainrotESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.BrainrotESP.set(togglesMap["Brainrot ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Player ESP"] ~= nil and _G.PlayerESP and _G.PlayerESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.PlayerESP.set(togglesMap["Player ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Clone ESP"] ~= nil and _G.CloneESP and _G.CloneESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.CloneESP.set(togglesMap["Clone ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Timer ESP"] ~= nil and _G.TimerESP and _G.TimerESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.TimerESP.set(togglesMap["Timer ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Mine ESP"] ~= nil and _G.MineESP and _G.MineESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.MineESP.set(togglesMap["Mine ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["AP ESP"] ~= nil and _G.APESP and _G.APESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.APESP.set(togglesMap["AP ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Allow Disallow ESP"] ~= nil and _G.AllowDisallowESP and _G.AllowDisallowESP.set then
            pcall(function() _G.AllowDisallowESP.set(togglesMap["Allow Disallow ESP"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Allow Friends"] ~= nil and _G.AllowFriends and _G.AllowFriends.set then
            pcall(function() _G.AllowFriends.set(togglesMap["Allow Friends"]) end)
        end

        -- Carpet Speed
        if data["carpetSpeed"] and _G.CarpetSpeed and _G.CarpetSpeed.setSpeed then
            pcall(function() _G.CarpetSpeed.setSpeed(data["carpetSpeed"]) end)
        end
        if togglesMap["Carpet Speed"] ~= nil and _G.CarpetSpeed and _G.CarpetSpeed.set then
            pcall(function() _G.CarpetSpeed.set(togglesMap["Carpet Speed"]) end)
        end

        -- Game Stretcher
        if (data["cameraFOV"] or data["gameStretcherFactor"]) and _G.GameStretcher then
            pcall(function()
                if data["cameraFOV"] and _G.GameStretcher.setFOV then _G.GameStretcher.setFOV(data["cameraFOV"]) end
                if data["gameStretcherFactor"] and _G.GameStretcher.setFactor then _G.GameStretcher.setFactor(data["gameStretcherFactor"]) end
            end)
        end

        -- 5. Update editor box with the loaded JSON
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local cleanJson = HttpService:JSONEncode(Config.data)
            if _G._KiroConfigEditorBox and _G._KiroConfigEditorBox.Parent then

    makeConfigCard(1, "Paste Config", "Import settings from clipboard", "Paste", 88, function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local body = nil
            pcall(function()
                if getclipboard then body = getclipboard() end
            end)
            if type(body) ~= "string" or #body < 2 then
                if showToast then showToast("Presse-papier vide", false) end
                return
            end
            body = body:gsub("^%s*\`\`\`json%s*", ""):gsub("^%s*\`\`\`%s*", ""):gsub("%s*\`\`\`%s*$", "")
            body = body:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            local okJ, data = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
            end)
            if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then
                if showToast then showToast("JSON invalide dans le presse-papier", false) end
                return
            end

            -- Update ConfigEditorBox
            if _G._KiroConfigEditorBox and _G._KiroConfigEditorBox.Parent then
                _G._KiroConfigEditorBox.Text = body
            end

            local okApply = applyConfigLive(data)
            if okApply then
                if showToast then showToast("Config collee et appliquee!", true) end
            else
                if showToast then showToast("Erreur lors de l'application", false) end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- 2. Copy Config (Photo Row 2)
    makeConfigCard(2, "Copy Config", "Export all settings to clipboard", "Copy", 88, function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if not Config or type(Config.data) ~= "table" then
                if showToast then showToast("Aucune donnee de config", false) end
                return
            end
            if Config.flush then pcall(function() Config.flush() end) end
            local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONEncode(Config.data)
            end)
            if not ok or type(encoded) ~= "string" or #encoded < 2 then
                if showToast then showToast("Erreur d'encodage", false) end
                return
            end

            -- Automatically populate the Config Editor box with the copied JSON!
            if _G._KiroConfigEditorBox and _G._KiroConfigEditorBox.Parent then
                _G._KiroConfigEditorBox.Text = encoded
            end

            local clipped = false
            pcall(function()
                if setclipboard then
                    setclipboard(encoded)
                    clipped = true
                elseif toclipboard then
                    toclipboard(encoded)
                    clipped = true
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if makefolder then
                    if not (isfolder and isfolder("KiroHub")) then makefolder("KiroHub") end
                    if not (isfolder and isfolder("KiroHub/Configs")) then makefolder("KiroHub/Configs") end
                end
                if writefile then
                    writefile("KiroHub/Configs/shared.json", encoded)
                    writefile("KiroHub/config_export.txt", encoded)
                end
            end)
            if clipped then
                if showToast then showToast("Config copiee dans le presse-papier!", true) end
            else
                if showToast then showToast("Config prete dans l'editeur", true) end
            end
        end)
    end)

        HueCursor.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, 4)
        HueCursor.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        HueCursor.Position               = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
        HueCursor.BackgroundColor3       = T.White
        HueCursor.BorderSizePixel        = 0
        HueCursor.ZIndex                 = 102
        HueCursor.Parent                 = HueBar
        Corner(HueCursor, 12)
        Stroke(HueCursor, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.3)

        local ApplyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        ApplyBtn.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 182, 0, 44)
        ApplyBtn.Position               = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 162)
        ApplyBtn.BackgroundColor3       = Theme.c1
        ApplyBtn.BorderSizePixel        = 0
        ApplyBtn.Text                   = ""
        ApplyBtn.AutoButtonColor        = false
        ApplyBtn.ZIndex                 = 101
        ApplyBtn.Parent                 = Picker
        Corner(ApplyBtn, 12)
        local applyStroke = Stroke(ApplyBtn, T.White, 1.4, 0.3)
        ApplyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(applyStroke, F, {Transparency = 0}) end)
        ApplyBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(applyStroke, F, {Transparency = 0.3}) end)

        local pickerState = {slot = 1, h = 0.75, s = 1, v = 0.97, pending = Theme.c1}

        local function updatePickerVisuals()
            local col = Color3.fromHSV(pickerState.h, pickerState.s, pickerState.v)
            pickerState.pending       = col
            SV.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromHSV(pickerState.h, 1, 1)
            SVCursor.Position         = UDim2.new(pickerState.s, 0, 1 - pickerState.v, 0)
            HueCursor.Position        = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, pickerState.h, 0)
            ApplyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = col
        end

        local function rgbToHsv(c)
            local r, g, b = c.R, c.G, c.B
            local mx = math.max(r, g, b)
            local mn = math.min(r, g, b)
            local d  = mx - mn
            local h  = 0
            if d > 0 then
                if mx == r then     h = ((g - b)/d) % 6
                elseif mx == g then h = ((b - r)/d) + 2
                else                h = ((r - g)/d) + 4 end
                h = h / 6
                if h < 0 then h = h + 1 end
            end
            local s = (mx > 0) and (d / mx) or 0
            return h, s, mx
        end

        local function openPicker(slot)
            pickerState.slot = slot
            local current = (slot == 1) and Theme.c1 or T.Bg
            pickerState.h, pickerState.s, pickerState.v = rgbToHsv(current)
            updatePickerVisuals()
            local guiSz = GUI.AbsoluteSize
            if isMobile then
                local px = math.max(4, math.floor((guiSz.X - 208) / 2))
                local py = math.max(4, math.floor((guiSz.Y - 214) / 2))
                Picker.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
            else
                local dot = (slot == 1) and Dot1 or Dot2
                local pos = dot.AbsolutePosition
                local px = math.max(8, math.min(pos.X - 100, guiSz.X - 216))
                local py = pos.Y + 24
                Picker.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
            end
            Picker.Visible = true
        end

        local function persistTheme()
            Config.set("theme_c1", { math.floor(Theme.c1.R*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c1.G*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c1.B*255+0.5) })
            Config.set("theme_c2", { math.floor(Theme.c2.R*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c2.G*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c2.B*255+0.5) })
            Config.set("theme_bg",  { math.floor(T.Bg.R*255+0.5),    math.floor(T.Bg.G*255+0.5),    math.floor(T.Bg.B*255+0.5)    })
        end

        local function applyLive()
            local col = pickerState.pending
            if pickerState.slot == 1 then
                -- Gamma-style accent apply
                Theme.c1 = col
                T.Primary = col
                T.Green = col
                if Dot1 then Dot1.BackgroundColor3 = col end
                if type(SetAccentColor) == "function" then
                    pcall(SetAccentColor, col)
                elseif type(Repaint) == "function" then
                    pcall(Repaint)
                end
            else
                -- Gamma-style background apply
                SetGuiColor(col)
                if Dot2 then Dot2.BackgroundColor3 = T.Bg end
            end
            persistTheme()
            pcall(function()
                if type(_G._KiroBroadcastTheme) == "function" then
                    _G._KiroBroadcastTheme()
                end
            end)
        end

        local function applyPicked()
            applyLive()
            persistTheme()
        end

        local function wireDot(btn, slot)
            if not btn then return end
            local function fire()
                pcall(openPicker, slot)
            end
            btn.Activated:Connect(fire)
            pcall(function()
                btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fire)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        fire()
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        wireDot(Dot1Btn, 1)
        wireDot(Dot2Btn, 2)
        -- Also allow clicking the frame itself
        pcall(function()
            if Dot1 then
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Dot1FrameHit"
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.Text = ""
                b.ZIndex = 62
                b.Parent = Dot1
                wireDot(b, 1)
            end
            if Dot2 then
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Dot2FrameHit"
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.Text = ""
                b.ZIndex = 62
                b.Parent = Dot2
                wireDot(b, 2)
            end
        end)
        CloseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() Picker.Visible = false end)
        ApplyBtn.Activated:Connect(applyPicked)

        local svDragging, hueDragging = false, false
        SV.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                svDragging = true
                local pos  = SV.AbsolutePosition
                local size = SV.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.s = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - pos.X) / size.X, 0, 1)
                pickerState.v = 1 - math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals(); applyLive()
            end
        end)
        SV.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then svDragging = false end
        end)
        HueBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                hueDragging = true
                local pos  = HueBar.AbsolutePosition
                local size = HueBar.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.h = math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals(); applyLive()
            end
        end)
        HueBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then hueDragging = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if svDragging then
                local pos  = SV.AbsolutePosition
                local size = SV.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.s = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - pos.X) / size.X, 0, 1)
                pickerState.v = 1 - math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals()
                applyLive()
            elseif hueDragging then
                local pos  = HueBar.AbsolutePosition
                local size = HueBar.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.h = math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals()
                applyLive()
            end
        end)
    end)()

    local function _KiroBroadcastTheme()
        local primary = (Theme and Theme.c1) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 45, 55)
        local bg = (T and T.Bg) or Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 14)
        local deep = (T and T.BgDeep) or Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 9)
        local card = (T and T.Card) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 24, 20)
        local soft = (T and T.Soft) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 28, 22)
        local text = (T and T.Text) or Color3.fromRGB(250, 245, 235)

        _G.coreTheme = _G.coreTheme or {}
        _G.coreTheme.primary = primary
        _G.coreTheme.secondary = text
        _G.coreTheme.bg = bg
        _G.coreTheme.card = card

        local modules = {
            _G.QuickAdminPanel, _G.AdminSpammer, _G.CommandCooldowns, _G.BoosterGUI,
            _G.TPBrainrot, _G.DropBrainrot,
            _G.ActionsPanel, _G.ActionsPanelMobile, _G.DefensePanel, _G.InstantStealV2, _G.StealTarget,
            _G.PlayerESP, _G.CloneESP, _G.TimerESP, _G.MineESP, _G.APESP, _G.BrainrotESP, _G.DeliveryESP,
            _G.AllowDisallowESP, _G.AllowFriends, _G._FH_CD_Panel, _G.FPSBooster, _G.GameStretcher,
            _G.DiscordLabel,
        }
        for _, mod in ipairs(modules) do
            if type(mod) == "table" then
                if type(mod.repaint) == "function" then
                    pcall(mod.repaint)
                elseif type(mod.applyTheme) == "function" then
                    pcall(mod.applyTheme, primary, text)
                end
            end
        end

        -- Repaint all hub toggles to match current accent / bg theme
        pcall(function()
            local reg = _G._KiroToggleReg
            if type(reg) == "table" then
                for _, ctrl in pairs(reg) do
                    if type(ctrl) == "table" and type(ctrl.refreshTheme) == "function" then
                        pcall(ctrl.refreshTheme)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._KiroPaintBannerTheme) == "function" then
                _G._KiroPaintBannerTheme()
            end
        end)

        local names = {
            "PanelGui_Actions", "PanelGui_ActionsMobile", "PanelGui_KiroQuickPanel", "PanelGui_Kiro Admin Spammer",
            "PanelGui_Command Cooldowns", "PanelGui_Booster", "PanelGui_Kiro Defense",
            "PanelGui_Defense", "PanelGui_Instant Steal V2",
            "PanelGui_StealTarget", "PanelGui_TP Brainrot", "KiroHubBanner", "KiroHubReopen",
        }
        local parents = {}
        pcall(function()
            if type(gethui) == "function" then
                local h = gethui()
                if h then table.insert(parents, h) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        pcall(function()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(parents, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function() if GUI then table.insert(parents, GUI) end end)

        local function recolorTree(root)
            if not root then return end
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Frame" or d.Name == "Main") then
                        if d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95 then
                            d.BackgroundColor3 = bg
                        end
                    end
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "TitleBar" or d.Name == "Header" or d.Name == "CDHdr") then
                        d.BackgroundColor3 = deep
                    end
                    if d:IsA("UIGradient") then
                        pcall(function()
                            d.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, primary),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                            })
                        end)
                    end
                    if d:IsA("UIStroke") and not d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
                        if d.Thickness and d.Thickness <= 2.5 then
                            pcall(function() d.Color = primary end)
                        end
                    end
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Badge" or d.Name == "Accent" or d.Name == "LogoBadge" or d.Name == "LogoBox") then
                        d.BackgroundColor3 = primary
                    end
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name ~= "StatusLabel" then
                        if d.Parent and (d.Parent.Name == "TitleBar" or d.Parent.Name == "Header" or d.Parent.Name == "CDHdr") then
                            d.TextColor3 = primary
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                pcall(function()
                    local o = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if o then
                        recolorTree(o)
                        if type(_G._KiroStyleLikeHub) == "function" then
                            local frame = o:IsA("ScreenGui") and (o:FindFirstChild("Frame") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")) or o
                            if frame and frame:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                local tb = frame:FindFirstChild("TitleBar") or frame:FindFirstChild("Header") or frame:FindFirstChild("CDHdr")
                                _G._KiroStyleLikeHub(frame, tb)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            local rb = _G._FH_ReopenBtn
            if rb then
                rb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 14)
                for _, d in ipairs(rb:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("UIStroke") and d.Name == "PillStroke" then
                        d.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 95, 20)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if PageTitle then PageTitle.TextColor3 = primary end
            if typeof(LogoBadge) == "Instance" then LogoBadge.BackgroundColor3 = primary end
            if Dot1 then Dot1.BackgroundColor3 = primary end
            if Dot2 then Dot2.BackgroundColor3 = bg end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if GUI then
                local ban = GUI:FindFirstChild("KiroHubBanner")
                if ban then recolorTree(ban) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._KiroPaintBannerTheme) == "function" then
                _G._KiroPaintBannerTheme()
            end
        end)
    end

    rootScale = Instance.new("UIScale")

        if _G.__KiroBridge then _G.__KiroBridge.rootScale = rootScale end

    local POP_IN  = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local POP_OUT = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

    visible = Config.get("hub_open", true)
    if not visible then
        Root.Visible    = false
        rootScale.Scale = 0
    end

    local curVisTween = nil
    setVisible = function(show)
        show = show and true or false
        if type(_G._KiroUpdateReopenState) == "function" then
            pcall(_G._KiroUpdateReopenState, show)
        end
        if show == visible then
            if show and Root and not Root.Visible then
                Root.Visible = true
                if rootScale then rootScale.Scale = _UI.desiredScale or 1 end
            end
            return
        end
        visible = show
        if Vis then Vis.open = show end
        Config.set("hub_open", show)
        if curVisTween then pcall(function() curVisTween:Cancel() end) end
        if show then
            Root.Visible = true
            if rootScale then
                if rootScale.Scale < 0.01 then rootScale.Scale = (_UI.desiredScale or 1) * 0.85 end
                curVisTween = TweenService:Create(rootScale, POP_IN, {Scale = _UI.desiredScale or 1})
                curVisTween:Play()
            end
        else
            if Picker then Picker.Visible = false end
            if rootScale then
                curVisTween = TweenService:Create(rootScale, POP_OUT, {Scale = 0})
                local t = curVisTween
                t.Completed:Connect(function(state)
                    if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not visible then
                        Root.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
                t:Play()
            else
                Root.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    if Vis then
        Vis.set = setVisible
        Vis.open = visible
        Vis.rootScale = rootScale
    end
    _G._FH_SetVisible = setVisible
    _G._FH_Vis = Vis
    if _G.__KiroBridge then
        _G.__KiroBridge.setVisible = setVisible
        _G.__KiroBridge.visible = visible
        _G.__KiroBridge.rootScale = rootScale
        _G.__KiroBridge.Vis = Vis
    end
